war_summary: War 139 is on day 107 with no winner. Colonials hold a dominant strategic position with approximately 185 bases to Wardens' 65 across 40 regions. The most intense combat zones are Endless Shore, Callahans Passage, Oarbreaker, Clahstra, Godcrofts, and Marban Hollow, where both factions are sustaining heavy casualties with accelerating trends and active base flipping. Endless Shore shows the highest intensity (1,750+ casualties/hr per side) with 47 events/24h across 5 active bases. Callahans Passage follows with 1,500+ casualties/hr per side and 6 events/24h. Oarbreaker leads in event volume (56 events/24h) with rapid base turnover across 5 bases. Clahstra has 11 events/24h with 3 highly active bases. Godcrofts shows 25 events/24h with accelerating casualties and a recent event at 02:31 UTC. Marban Hollow has surged to 2,500+ casualties/hr per side with accelerating trends. Wardens hold quiet northern regions (Basin Sionnach, Clanshead, Howl County, Viper Pit, Weathered Expanse, Speaking Woods, Reaching Trail) but face heavy pressure in Speaking Woods (1,900+ casualties/2h). Large Colonial rear areas (Deadlands, Drowned Vale, Allods Bight, etc.) are quiet with minimal casualties.
